metadata.description: Claude skills from the agents that run my business: operator discipline and an operator starter, building with Claude, go-to-market, marketing and UK business. Free, MIT licensed.

plugins.name: operator-discipline
plugins.description: How an agent behaves when doing real work for a busy founder: challenge a bad brief, hand back solutions not problems, write guides and playbooks people can follow, and turn meetings into decisions and actions.

plugins.name: operator-starter
plugins.description: A way of working for running a small business or side project with Claude Code: an interview that writes your CLAUDE.md rules and memory folder, approval-gate hooks that ask before Claude sends, publishes, pays or deletes, and a Friday weekly review.

plugins.name: agent-builder
plugins.description: MCP servers and MCP Apps that ship and get listed, agent security that removes risk rather than describing it, a loop for shipping real work with coding agents, and turning a manual process into a skill.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Outbound for founders and small B2B teams: find prospects from public signals with a sourced reason to contact each, and run sequences that do not burn your sending domains.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Content and search for small teams, built to get you found and cited by AI answer engines as well as Google.

plugins.name: uk-business
plugins.description: Running a small UK limited company with Claude: the rules, the deadlines, and knowing how much cash you really have. Reference, not advice.
